text.p: CMS Energy Corp said Tuesday it formed a partnership with Argentina's Entre Rios Province to bring new business and industry to the province.
No details were released. The announcement was made by CMS Senior Vice President John Clark at a Michigan Hispanic Chamber of Commerce meeting.

The meeting included a visiting delegation of government and economic development officials from Entre Rios. The group of nine Entre Rios Government officials, including Vice Governor Hector Alanis, is visiting the Midwest to observe CMS Energy's economic development activities in Michigan, the company said.

CMS Energy's international utility operation business unit, CMS Electric and Gas, is the managing partner of a consortium which last year acquired a majority ownership interest in the electric utility serving Entre Rios, Empresa Distribuidora de Electricidad de Entre Rios S.A.
